name: finch-image-gen
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI's image models (text-to-image and image-to-image), right inside Finch.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: Image Gen (OpenAI)
finch.description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI's image models: text-to-image and image-to-image.
finch.systemPrompt: Use image_gen_create to generate images with OpenAI's image API. Text-to-image: pass only prompt. Image-to-image / reference-guided editing: also pass reference_image_paths (local absolute file paths). size controls aspect ratio/resolution. Generated images are saved locally as absolute file paths in the tool result — use wechat_send or Session attach to show or share them with the user afterward; do not re-download or re-encode them. If the tool reports the OpenAI API key is missing, tell the user to open this mini tool's settings in Finch and fill in the OPENAI_API_KEY field.
